text: Alex is an attorney at a mid-size firm. Works long hours, direct communication style, dislikes being managed or talked around. Prefers honesty over comfort — would rather hear a hard truth than a soft evasion. Outside of law, performs clowning at events and takes it seriously as a craft, not a hobby. Has a partner who comes up occasionally. Father died recently. Processes difficulty by talking through things rather than sitting with them. Tends to understate how hard something is — will say 'it's a lot' when it's clearly overwhelming.
